note: Increased damage from 9 to 10 per pellet. Converted to the sheets' unit: 12 pellets at the time, so 10 x 12 = 120, the figure 6.6.0 later gives as the prior value.
Slightly decreased the size of the pellet distribution, making the weapon more accurate
Decreased the reload time for reloading one cartridge from 2.2s to 2.1s, two from 2.4s to 2.25s, and three from 2.6s to 2.45s
Decreased the radius of the weapon's projectile from 10cm to 5cm, making it easier to avoid accidentally hitting nearby surfaces
Decreased self-damage multiplier from 1.6 to 1.25, meaning it will now do less damage to the player using it should they accidentally hit themselves
While the CL-40 has been in a much better place recently than in the past, we feel these small 'quality of life' changes will improve the experience of using it
Added a slight adjustment to FoV when charging up for a secondary attack, to make it clearer when the attack is at maximum charge
Decreased damage per bullet from 24 to 23

Decreased the fire rate from 230 RPM to 220 RPM. Held as text rather than recorded as RPM: the FAMAS is a burst weapon and the sheets measure it at ~1080 RPM of bullets, so the note's figure counts burst cycles.
Decreased rate of fire from 280 RPM to 270 RPM
Decreased damage from 13 to 11 per pellet. Converted to the sheets' unit: the Model fires 9 pellets, so 11 x 9 = 99.

Increased min damage falloff multiplier from 0.6 to 0.7, meaning the Model 1887 retains the same damage at max range as in update 5.7. Recorded as a retained-damage percentage to match the sheets' column.
Decreased the bolt action animation duration from 1.25s to 1.05s, slightly increasing the SR-84's rate of fire
Increased the length of the Sword's secondary attack hit sweep by 55cm
This change reverts the change made in 4.6 and should mean the primary and secondary attacks of the Sword now have a more consistent length
